src:
MOV     AL, 3            ; 0000 0011
CALL    SHOWBIN
SHL     AL, 1            ; 6
CALL    SHOWBIN
MOV     CL, 5
SHL     AL, CL           ; 6 * 32 = 192
CALL    SHOWBIN
CALL    SHOWCF
SHL     AL, 1            ; 384 does not fit: CF = 1
CALL    SHOWBIN
CALL    SHOWCF

SHOWBIN PROC    NEAR             ; print AL as 8 binary digits and a space
PUSHF                            ; keep the caller's flags
PUSH    AX
PUSH    BX
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     BL, AL
MOV     CX, 8
NEXTBIT:
SHL     BL, 1            ; the top bit falls into CF
MOV     DL, "0"
ADC     DL, 0            ; "0" + CF = "0" or "1"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    NEXTBIT
MOV     DL, " "
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
POP     DX
POP     CX
POP     BX
POP     AX
POPF
RET
SHOWBIN ENDP
SHOWCF  PROC    NEAR             ; print "CF=0" or "CF=1" and a space
PUSHF
PUSH    AX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DL, "0"
ADC     DL, 0            ; "0" + CF, before anything changes CF
PUSH    DX
MOV     AH, 09h
MOV     DX, OFFSET CFTXT
INT     21h
POP     DX
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
MOV     DL, " "
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
POP     DX
POP     AX
POPF
RET
SHOWCF  ENDP
CFTXT   DB      "CF=$"
